extension.summary: Pops up a UniFi Protect camera when something happens
extension.description: Runs in the background, listens to UniFi Protect for smart detections (person, package, vehicle, animal, doorbell ring, motion) and shows that camera in a corner of the screen for a few seconds. Uses the official Protect Integration API with an API key. Also has a full-screen view of up to 9 cameras, opened from Programs or with RunScript(service.moodycam,fullscreen). No extra add-ons needed.
